snippet.title: GUTTERGLOW - Gameplay Trailer | A bowling roguelike with real pin physics
snippet.description:
GUTTERGLOW is a bowling roguelike set in an 80s neon bowling alley. The ball and the pins are real physics bodies, so every point comes from pins that actually fell: no hidden dice rolls.

Build your ball with pins, tricks and upgrades until one throw multiplies into a huge score. 12 bosses change the lane, 13 lane types change the physics, three modes.

Coming April 2027. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5400290/

#indiegame #roguelike #bowling
